resources.string: No additional databases imported. The signed suite deny-list above always applies.
%1$d database(s), %2$d hashes total — checked on every scan alongside the signed deny-list.
Accepts SHA-256 hash lists: one hash per line (MalwareBazaar dumps), hash,label CSV, or ClamAV-style hash:size:name. Imports are unsigned — trust the feed you import.
Not a recognizable hash list — nothing imported.
Last passive pass: no rule hits.
Passive means passive: these signatures scan APK contents already on your device. This is not a network monitor — a rootless app cannot capture traffic, and this one never claims to.
No valid Snort rules found — nothing imported.
Imported rules removed; built-in seed remains active.

Checks file hashes against VirusTotal\'s multi-engine database. Requires your own free API key. What leaves the device: the SHA-256 hash of a scanned APK — never the file itself. Off by default; without a key this app opens no network connection at all.
API key saved on this device.
Hash lookups active during scans; results are cached on-device.
No lookups — the network path stays dead.
Re-runs the complete analysis over every user app daily, so newly imported definitions catch already-installed apps.
Streams installed APKs through the active Snort-format ruleset. Incremental — unchanged apps are skipped.
Looks up sideloaded apps\' hashes on VirusTotal. Rate-limited and capped per run; cached results are free.
Configure and enable VirusTotal above first.
Signature rule hit in %1$s — open to review
Signature rule hits in %1$d apps — open to review
